feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. Evidence: iteration 7 (12 mm footprint, 0.5 kg) is the best design at 645.9. Oval finish is 1.00 and s-bend finish 0.85, with s-bend steering_oscillation 0.487. The slalom still ends off track at max_error 0.062, the 0.06 m floor, with progress 0.385 and line_loss 0.45. Iteration 6 showed 0.5 kg lifted slalom progress from 0.34 to 0.39, and iteration 4 showed that a narrower track overshoots (s-bend oscillation 0.45). Iteration 5 showed that wider reach cuts slalom progress, so reach is not the limit. This candidate tests only the next mass step (0.5 to 0.45 kg) with the controller unchanged. Interpret the next race as follows. If slalom progress rises above 0.39 or a slalom finish appears while s-bend steering_oscillation stays below about 0.55, keep 0.45 kg and keep the 12 mm footprint. If s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.55 without a slalom gain, return to 0.5 kg, since the lower inertia is overshooting. If the slalom is unchanged with line loss near 0.45 and max_error near 0.06, stop changing geometry and report that the controller's kd or base_speed is the limit.
requested_changes: If slalom progress rises above 0.39 or any slalom finish appears while s-bend steering_oscillation stays below about 0.55, keep mass 0.45 kg and the 12 mm footprint, since mass 0.5 kg gave the slalom its only gain (0.34 to 0.39, iteration 6).

If s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.55 (iteration 7: 0.487) with no slalom gain, revert to mass 0.5 kg with the 12 mm footprint, since iteration 7 is the best tested design and the lower inertia is overshooting.

If the slalom stays at about 0.385 progress with max_error at 0.06 m, do not change geometry again; report the result so the Integrator can adjust kd or base_speed, since reach (iteration 5), track width (iteration 4) and mass have all failed to move the slalom.
